title: On Measuring Gender Bias in Translation of Gender-neutral Pronouns
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It is designed to measure gender bias in the translation of gender-neutral pronouns from Korean to English, specifically in sentences containing sentiment-related and occupation-related words.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its focus is exclusively on gender bias.
